description: Fixed 3-segment Blob test vector (docs/CRYPTO.md §4.4 and §8): 2 MiB + 5 B of plaintext, split into 2 full 1 MiB segments plus one short (5 B) final segment. The ciphertext lives alongside this manifest in ciphertext_file (too large to inline as hex). All byte fields here are lowercase hex. Generated with blob::Encryptor::new_for_test, a #[cfg(test)]-only constructor that pins the DEK and both nonces; production code has no way to supply either (docs/CRYPTO.md §8).
plaintext_pattern: byte i of the plaintext equals i % 256
